policy: Emitters, curves, gradients, textures and the tracer preset come from a headless Godot dump of the scenes the client spawns; numbers that only live in GDScript are matched on their exact source lines. Nothing is redrawn, retimed or measured by eye.

trailLead.line: var shell: Projectile = Projectile.create(current_shell().duplicate(), self.gun.global_position, dir, self, true, 0.1, gsp_pos - gun.global_basis.z * randf_range(0.75, 1) * current_shell().speed * 0.005)
